appDescription.message: Select an area, then scroll and stitch to capture the entire page.
appDescription.description: Extension description shown by Chrome and in the Web Store.

unsupportedTitle.message: Screenshots are not supported on this page
unsupportedTitle.description: Toolbar action tooltip on pages where screenshots are not supported.

selectHintEmpty.message: Drag to select the area to capture
selectHintEmpty.description: Hint shown before a selection is made.

selectHintReselect.description: Hint shown when a selection already exists.

capture.description: Primary button label for capturing the selected area.

captureFullPage.description: Primary button label for capturing the whole page.

selectionSize.message: $WIDTH$ px wide · capture from here to the end of the page
selectionSize.description: Selection size label; $WIDTH$ is the selection width in CSS pixels.

resultTitle.description: Title of the capture result overlay.

resultMetaSplit.description: Meta note when the capture is split; $COUNT$ is the number of parts.

downloadOne.description: Download button label for a single PNG.

downloadMany.description: Download button label for multiple PNGs; $COUNT$ is the number of parts.

copied.description: Note shown after a successful copy.

copiedScaled.message: Copied (scaled down to fit the size limit)
copiedScaled.description: Note shown after copying a capture scaled down to fit the size limit.

copyFailed.message: Copy failed ($REASON$) — please use Download instead
copyFailed.description: Copy failure note; $REASON$ is the underlying error.

reselect.description: Button label that returns to selection mode.

toBlobFailed.description: Error shown when canvas.toBlob produces no image.

statusWarmup.description: Badge status text during the warm-up scroll.

errorSelectionBeyondEnd.message: The selection starts beyond the end of the content — please reselect
errorSelectionBeyondEnd.description: Error shown when the selection starts past the content end.

errorZeroCropWidth.message: The crop area is 0 px wide — please reselect
errorZeroCropWidth.description: Error shown when the selected crop area is zero pixels wide.

captureFailed.description: Capture failure message; $REASON$ is the underlying error.

errorTallInnerScroller.message: Inner scroll containers taller than the viewport are not supported yet — use Capture full page instead
errorTallInnerScroller.description: Error shown when an inner scroll container is taller than the viewport.
